name: pathways-crm-api
description: Pathways CRM API — read-first, low-cost TypeScript (Fastify) service backing the Pathways CRM UI.

scripts.dev:pg: DATA_BACKEND=postgres DB_HOST=localhost DB_PORT=5433 DB_NAME=pathways DB_USER=pathways DB_PASSWORD=pathways DB_SSLMODE=disable PORT=8081 tsx watch src/server.ts
scripts.db:migrate: DB_HOST=${DB_HOST:-localhost} DB_PORT=${DB_PORT:-5433} DB_NAME=${DB_NAME:-pathways} DB_USER=${DB_USER:-pathways} DB_PASSWORD=${DB_PASSWORD:-pathways} DB_SSLMODE=${DB_SSLMODE:-disable} tsx src/db/migrate.ts
scripts.db:seed: DB_HOST=${DB_HOST:-localhost} DB_PORT=${DB_PORT:-5433} DB_NAME=${DB_NAME:-pathways} DB_USER=${DB_USER:-pathways} DB_PASSWORD=${DB_PASSWORD:-pathways} DB_SSLMODE=${DB_SSLMODE:-disable} tsx src/db/seed-db.ts
